decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter builds directly on the firm's core salami and organic expertise and has stayed on the website for two years, so the firm can read its results well and keeps it.
The premium sharing salami snack was extended in 2024 with Classic and poultry variants, which shows the firm assimilated early market feedback and is building the line on its core salami competence.
The organic boiled pork sausage is a recent launch that closely matches the firm's established meat processing and organic knowledge, so management will keep it to learn from its first full year.

The thinly sliced chicken breast extends the firm's existing poultry and organic know-how with two flavour variants, but it is a newer category, so it carries somewhat more risk while early results are still being interpreted.
The organic herb-coated salami is a small variation within the firm's core salami expertise and gets its own website page, so the firm keeps it while it evaluates the first sales.
